dashboard: Here's your magic button! 🪄 Tap this to generate a professional English quote in under 30 seconds — just describe the job in Spanish or upload a photo and AI does the rest.
Add a new client right from here. Every client you add stays saved with their full history — quotes, invoices, photos, messages.
Create an invoice from scratch. If you already had an approved quote, better use the 'Convert to Invoice' button in the quote detail — it fills itself in.
These numbers are your real-time business pulse. Tap them to dive into each section's detail.
How much do they owe you? Here you see the total pending. Tap 'View invoices' to send payment reminders to late clients.
When you need to change your business info, logo, address or phone — it's here. You also change your password.
clients: Add a new client here. Only the name and phone are required — everything else (email, address, notes) you can fill in later.
Tap any client in the list to see their FULL HISTORY: all their quotes, invoices, messages and photos. One screen with everything you've done with that person.
quotes: Here you create a new quote. AI helps you write it in professional English even if you describe it in Spanish. You can even upload a photo of the job and AI analyzes it. 🤖
Filter your quotes by status — draft, sent, approved, declined, converted to invoice. It helps you know which ones need follow-up.
Tap any quote to open the detail. From there you copy the public link to send the client via WhatsApp, mark as approved, generate the PDF, or convert it into an invoice.
invoices: Create a new invoice. If you're coming from an approved quote, better convert the quote from its detail — it fills the line items automatically. And if you signed an agreement tied to the quote, the invoice is created as a DRAFT only.
Each invoice can be draft, sent, paid, partially paid or overdue. Tap it to record client payments or send the payment link.
agreements: Generate legal contracts in English with AI in 15 seconds. AI detects the type of service you describe and builds the right clauses — liability, cancellation, warranty, everything.
Each contract has a public link you send to the client. They open it, sign with their finger or the 'I Accept' button, and it's saved with date, time and signature. Valid under the ESIGN Act. 🖋️
🎯 Pro tip: when the client signs a contract tied to a quote, the invoice is created as a DRAFT only. You just review it and send the link. Getting paid was never this easy.
jobs: Schedule a job here. You set the date, time, client and address. If it's recurring (every Monday, weekly, monthly) you mark it and it repeats itself on the calendar.
Jobs have a status pipeline: new lead → estimate sent → approved → scheduled → in progress → waiting payment → completed. It helps you know where each project stands.
calendar: Jump back to today with this button. Useful when you're browsing months ahead.
Navigate between weeks or months with the ‹ › arrows.
Tap any day to create or view the jobs scheduled that day. Recurring jobs (weekly lawn mowing, etc.) appear automatically on each date they're due.
card: Welcome to your Smart Card! 💳 This is your public URL — share it via WhatsApp or QR and your clients save it on their iPhone like a contact. It's your passive marketing 24/7.
Here you tell AI what kind of business you have (Roofing, Lawn Care, Cleaning, etc.). It's the main ingredient so your card looks and responds like your industry.

🤖 Pro tip: here you train your card's AI. Tell it how you quote, areas you serve, cancellation policy, etc. When a client asks something in the chat, the AI answers with YOUR info — and captures the lead automatically.
This is your brand color. It changes the header of your digital card. Pick one that represents you — green, blue, whatever.
Add every service you offer with a price (or 'Quote on request'). Clients see them when they open your card. This saves you explaining the same thing 100 times over WhatsApp.
messages: Pick the client you're going to write to (optional — if you don't pick one, write generic).
Tell AI what you want to say IN SPANISH — for example: 'remind them they owe me 50% of Thursday's job'. AI translates it into professional English.
Tap here and AI generates the full message in English — ready to copy and paste into WhatsApp/SMS/email.
When the message is generated, a 'Copy' button appears below. Copy it and paste it from your WhatsApp/SMS/email app — so you don't depend on our services to send. Your usual WhatsApp app!
scope: Describe the job IN SPANISH — what's included, what's not, materials, timelines. AI builds it into a professional English Scope of Work, ready to attach to your quote or contract.
Tap here and AI writes it. It includes 'what's IN' and 'what's NOT' — this saves you fights with clients who later say 'but I thought it also included...'
When the scope is generated, a 'Copy' button appears. Paste it wherever you need — in the quote notes, in an email to the client, or in the contract.

roofing.label: Roof Replacement
roofing.descText: Replace the entire roof of a 1,500 sq ft house. Tear off and dispose of the old shingles, install new synthetic underlayment with ice & water shield, install GAF architectural shingles, replace boots and flashing, add a ridge vent and do a full cleanup with a magnetic sweep. Costs: tear-off $1.20/sq ft, installed shingles $3.50/sq ft, underlayment $950, flashing & ventilation $700. 50% deposit to schedule.

painting.label: Interior Painting
painting.descText: Paint the interior of a 3-bedroom, 2-bath house. Protect floors and furniture, patch holes and minor drywall repairs, caulk trim and sand, apply 2 coats of premium paint on walls, ceilings and trim, and do a final cleanup. Costs: prep $450, walls $0.95/sq ft (2,200 sq ft), ceilings & trim $520. 30% deposit.

concrete.label: Concrete Driveway
concrete.descText: Build a new 600 sq ft concrete driveway. Excavate and remove the old surface, grade and compact the base, set forms and rebar reinforcement, pour 4-inch concrete with a broom finish and seal it. Costs: excavation & grading $1,200, concrete $7.50/sq ft, finishing & sealing $600. 50% deposit.
